cases.title: A rule can be created for every trigger kind on Customer, Invoice and Payment; the creator owns it
cases.steps: admin POST /api/automation/rules for {ENTITY_CREATED, ENTITY_UPDATED, ENTITY_CREATED_OR_UPDATED, SCHEDULE_DAILY 09:00, SCHEDULE_WEEKLY MONDAY 09:00, MANUAL} x {CUSTOMER, INVOICE, PAYMENT}, enabled=false
cases.expected: DESIGN §6.14: 200 RuleDto each; trigger echoed; owner = admin; status DISABLED; schedule rules carry time/day/zone
cases.actual: 18 rules created (ids 6..23), all echoed, owner admin, DISABLED

cases.title: Invalid trigger definitions are refused with field errors
cases.steps: POST rules with time "25:00", weekly without day, zone "Mars/Base", kind "ENTITY_DELETED", entityType "PROMISE"
cases.expected: DESIGN §6.14 field rules: 400 each, with fieldErrors on trigger.*

cases.title: A rule needs 1..5 actions with unique keys
cases.steps: POST a rule with 0 actions, 6 actions, and 2 actions sharing a key

cases.actual: {"zero":[400,{"actions":"A rule does 1 to 5 things"}],"six":[400,{"actions":"A rule does 1 to 5 things"}],"dupKeys":[400,{"actions[1].key":"Two actions have the same key"}],"five":200}

cases.title: Editing a rule bumps its version; a stale version is a 409
cases.steps: create rule; PUT with version 0 (rename) -> 200; PUT again with version 0
cases.expected: DESIGN §6.14: PUT -> RuleDto with version+1; stale -> 409
cases.actual: {"first":[200,1,"renamed-mukg4ijm280a"],"stale":[409,"This record changed while you were working on it; reload and try again"]}

cases.title: Disable and enable a rule; a schedule gets its next run only while enabled
cases.steps: create SCHEDULE_DAILY 09:00 UTC enabled; POST /disable; POST /enable
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.8: nextRunAt set when enabled, cleared on disable, recomputed on enable; status ACTIVE/DISABLED

cases.title: Deleting a rule removes it from reads; its audit trail stays
cases.steps: create rule; DELETE /rules/{id}; GET /rules/{id}; GET /rules?filter=id:eq:{id}; GET /api/audit?entityType=RULE&entityId={id}
cases.expected: DESIGN §6.14: 204; then 404; not listed; audit has RULE_CREATED and RULE_DELETED

cases.title: Only the owner edits a rule; an administrator must confirm taking it over
cases.steps: nora creates a MANUAL North rule; admin PUT without confirmOwnershipChange; admin PUT with it; nora then PUT (no longer owner, no AUTOMATION_ADMIN)
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.7: admin 400 fieldErrors.confirmOwnershipChange, then 200 with owner = admin; nora 403 afterwards
cases.actual: {"noConfirm":[400,{"confirmOwnershipChange":"This makes you the rule's owner; it will act with your access. Confirm to go ahead"}],"withConfirm":[200,{"id":1,"name":"System Administrator","active":true}],"nora":403}

cases.title: Rule names are unique (case-insensitive) among live rules
cases.steps: create rule "Dup-<tag>"; create "dup-<tag>"
cases.expected: DESIGN §3.6: unique among non-deleted rules, case-insensitive -> 400 fieldErrors.name

cases.title: A user without AUTOMATION_MANAGE cannot create rules; without AUTOMATION_VIEW cannot list them
cases.steps: cashier (seeded role) POST /api/automation/rules; GET /api/automation/rules
cases.expected: DESIGN §6.14 gates: 403 on create (AUTOMATION_MANAGE) and on list (AUTOMATION_VIEW) unless the role holds it

cases.title: Rules list and summary answer with counts and filters
cases.steps: GET /api/automation/rules?filter=enabled:eq:false&sort=name,asc; GET /rules/summary
cases.expected: DESIGN §6.14: PageResponse of RuleSummary; summary {active, disabled, suspended, failedRuns24h} consistent with the list

cases.title: AND condition acts on exactly the records matching every filter (and matches the list page)
cases.steps: fixture North customer C with invoices 1000/6000/2000(part paid)/3000; MANUAL INVOICE rule AND(customerId:eq:C,total:gt:1500) + CREATE_TASK; preview; run now; GET /api/invoices with the same filters
cases.expected: PRD A2: acts on 6000, 2000, 3000 only; preview matchCount 3; same ids as the list page filter

cases.title: OR group inside AND: acts on records matching any branch; non-matching records are left alone
cases.steps: fixture; rule AND(customerId:eq:C, OR(total:gt:5000, status:eq:PARTIALLY_PAID)); run now
cases.expected: PRD A2 (AND and OR): acts on the 6000 and the partly paid 2000 only; 1000 and 3000 untouched

cases.title: Top-level OR of two AND groups (depth 3)
cases.steps: fixture; rule OR(AND(customerId:eq:C,total:lt:1500), AND(customerId:eq:C,total:eq:3000)); run now
cases.expected: PRD A2: acts on the 1000 and the 3000 only

cases.title: Conditions work over Customer fields (outstanding) and Payment fields (amount)
cases.steps: customers A (outstanding 7000) and B (outstanding 1000); CUSTOMER rule AND(OR(id:eq:A,id:eq:B), outstanding:gt:5000); payments 500 and 300 on A; PAYMENT rule AND(customerId:eq:A, amount:gt:400); run both
cases.expected: PRD A2 "filters over that entity's fields": customer rule acts on A only; payment rule acts on the 500 payment only

cases.title: Invalid condition trees are refused at save with the path of the bad node
cases.steps: POST rules with: unknown field; bad operator; bad enum value; empty group; depth 5; 31 leaves
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.2: 400 with fieldErrors like condition.children[1].filter; limits depth<=4, leaves<=30, empty group rejected

cases.title: An UPDATED rule on a clock-driven column saves with the "not an update" warning
cases.steps: POST ENTITY_UPDATED INVOICE rule with condition overdue:eq:true
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.8.3/§6.14: 200 with warnings containing "Becoming overdue is not an update"
cases.actual: [200,["Becoming overdue is not an update; use a daily schedule to catch it"]]

cases.title: A rule with no condition matches every record the owner may see
cases.steps: nora (MANAGE North only for tasks) previews a MANUAL INVOICE rule with condition null restricted to NORTH; compare with GET /api/invoices?regionIds=NORTH as nora
cases.expected: DESIGN §3.6 "Null means every record": matchCount = number of North invoices nora sees

cases.steps: North customer (Collection POC nora) invoice 1234 due +20d; MANUAL rule id:eq:I, CREATE_TASK title "Chase {{Invoice.Number}} ({{Invoice.Balance}})", description "{{Customer.Name}} owes {{Customer.Outstanding}} in {{Customer.Region}}", due INVOICE_DUE_DATE-3, assignees [COLLECTION_POC@CUSTOMER, USER sam]; run now; GET /api/tasks/{id}
cases.expected: title "Chase INV-20260927-0031 (₹1,234.00)", description "AutoCust-mukg4q4m4c47 owes ₹1,234.00 in North", due 2026-10-14, people [3,4]

cases.title: ONCE_PER_RECORD acts once however often the rule runs; preview shows it as already done
cases.steps: rule with CREATE_TASK repeat ONCE_PER_RECORD on one invoice; run now twice; preview with ruleId
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.5: one task; second run acts on nothing (skipped); preview sample alreadyDone contains the action key

cases.title: EVERY_TIME acts on every run; the "no open task" guard holds it back while one is open
cases.steps: rule A: CREATE_TASK EVERY_TIME, no guard -> run twice; rule B: EVERY_TIME + onlyIfNoOpenTask -> run, run, mark task DONE, run
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.5: A makes 2 tasks; B makes 1, then skips (open task), then makes a 2nd after the first is DONE
cases.actual: {"everyTime":2,"guardedAfter2Runs":1,"guardedRun2Effects":[["SKIPPED","An open task from this rule is already on this record"]],"markDone":200,"guardedAfterDone":2}

cases.title: CREATE_PROMISE takes the amount from the record, dates it, links the invoice and uses the Collection POC
cases.steps: invoice 3000 with 1000 paid; CREATE_PROMISE amount FIELD Invoice.Balance, promisedDate TODAY+7, collectionPoc null, notes "Auto {{Invoice.Number}}", linkRecord; run now
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.5: promise 2000.00 dated today+7, Collection POC = customer's (nora), linked to the invoice, notes rendered

cases.title: CREATE_PROMISE on a fully paid invoice is skipped ("Nothing owed"); a second run does not duplicate an open promise
cases.steps: invoice 500 fully paid -> rule CREATE_PROMISE FIELD Invoice.Balance; run. Invoice 800 unpaid -> CREATE_PROMISE EVERY_TIME with onlyIfNoOpenPromise; run twice
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.5: first effect SKIPPED (Nothing owed), no promise; second rule makes 1 promise, then SKIPPED
cases.actual: {"paidEffect":[["SKIPPED","Nothing owed"]],"promisesOnPaid":0,"promisesOnOpen":1,"secondRun":[["SKIPPED","An open promise is already linked to this invoice"]]}

cases.title: CREATE_DISPUTE opens one internal dispute with a rendered reason and record-level assignees; the customer cannot see it

cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.11: one PENDING dispute, internal=true, origin AUTOMATION, ruleId, reason rendered, assignee resolves to sam; second run no duplicate; customer login 404

cases.title: SEND_EMAIL saves an outbound email on the record with rendered subject/body, from the role holder, to the customer
cases.steps: North customer (Collection POC nora) invoice 2222; SEND_EMAIL from COLLECTION_POC@CUSTOMER, to [CUSTOMER], subject "Invoice {{Invoice.Number}} for {{Customer.Name}}", body "Balance {{Invoice.Balance}} due {{Invoice.DueDate}}"; run; GET /api/emails?entityType=INVOICE&entityId=I
cases.expected: PRD A3/A4; mail transport none -> one OUTBOUND email, status NOT_SENT/NOT_CONFIGURED, subject/body rendered, from nora, to the customer address, sentBy admin (owner); effect DONE with the "not configured" warning

cases.title: An automation email never goes to a colleague who cannot see the record
cases.steps: North invoice; SEND_EMAIL to [USER wendy (West only), USER sam (North MANAGE)]; run

cases.title: A task assignee who cannot see the record is dropped with a warning; the task is still made
cases.steps: North invoice; CREATE_TASK assignees [USER wendy (West only), USER nora]; run
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.9.1: effect DONE with warning "Wendy West cannot see this record, so was not assigned"; task assignees = nora only
cases.actual: {"effect":["DONE",["Wendy West cannot see this record, so was not assigned"]],"assignees":[3]}

cases.title: Placeholders are offered per level: Customer.* on every rule, plus the record level of the rule's entity
cases.steps: GET /api/automation/placeholders?entityType=CUSTOMER|INVOICE|PAYMENT
cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.4: CUSTOMER -> Customer + General; INVOICE -> Customer + Invoice (Number, Balance…) + General; PAYMENT -> Customer + Payment + General

cases.title: Payment and Customer rules render their own placeholders; a fallback is used when a value is empty
cases.steps: payment 600 on a North customer: PAYMENT rule CREATE_TASK "Paid {{Payment.Amount}} ({{Payment.Number}}) by {{Customer.Name}} for {{Payment.Invoices}}"; CUSTOMER rule CREATE_TASK "{{Customer.Name}} owes {{Customer.Outstanding}} [{{Customer.Region}}] CP={{Customer.CollectionPoc}} SP={{Customer.SuccessPoc|Our team}}"

cases.title: A role held by several people resolves to the primary for placeholders, the email sender and the promise Collection POC
cases.steps: customer with Collection POCs sam (primary) and nora; INVOICE rule: task title "{{Customer.CollectionPoc}}", SEND_EMAIL from COLLECTION_POC@CUSTOMER to CUSTOMER, CREATE_PROMISE collectionPoc COLLECTION_POC@CUSTOMER; run

cases.title: An email addressed To a role held by several people goes To every holder

cases.expected: to [Sam South, Nora North] (any order), neither in cc

cases.title: A record-level role (Sales POC of this invoice) resolves to the invoice's own POC, not the customer's
cases.steps: customer Collection POC nora; invoice with Sales POC sam; CREATE_TASK assignees [SALES_POC@RECORD]; run
cases.expected: PRD A3 role-at-a-level: the task resolves to sam

cases.expected: DESIGN §6.14: 202 {runId, eventId, status QUEUED, scheduledFor}; run becomes SUCCEEDED with triggerType MANUAL, requestedBy admin, matched 1, done 1; audit RULE_RUN_REQUESTED; rule lastRun set

cases.expected: DESIGN §5.10.9: tasks on i1 and i3 only; 51 ids -> 400 fieldErrors.recordIds

cases.title: A disabled rule can still be run by hand

cases.title: Run history: runs list (newest first, filterable), run detail and its effects

cases.title: Automation health is for administrators
cases.steps: GET /api/automation/health as admin and as nora
